newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dallah Real Estate and Tourism Development Co of Saudi Arabia is seeking Saudi and Gulf firms to invest in tourism projects.
- An Asian carrying 261 grams of heroin was arrested in Jeddah.
- Saudi businessmen to visit Russia this month to promote trade and joint venture.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines informed Air India it would take action against air carriers flouting the air-fare structure.
- A new cement plant for Saudi's Southern Province Cement Co will start production later this month.
- Saudi agriculture minister says loans worth more than 28 billion riyals and grants worth 11 billion riyals had been given to Saudi farmers until 1995.
